message.content:
Structured linen-blend blazer, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, soft sage green (#8DA399), lightweight woven fabric
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, straight cut through thigh to ankle, deep charcoal gray (#36454F), heavy crepe material
Minimalist silk camisole top, draped neckline, hip-length hem, warm beige (#D2CFC3), smooth satin weave
Chunky leather loafers, square toe, mid-calf height, cognac brown (#A07856), full-grain leather finish
Delicate gold chain necklace, 18-inch length, fine link design, polished yellow gold plate

This outfit balances professional polish with creative fluidity, perfect for an autumn office day. The high-waisted trousers and structured blazer subtly elongate the silhouette while drawing attention upward to the neckline and face, effectively quieting the belly zone as requested. Earthy tones like sage green and cognac brown offer a warm, grounded aesthetic suitable for fall weather without needing an outer layer at these temperatures.
